method: Reverse DCF: solve FCF growth g so PV of 10y FCF + terminal (g_term 2.5%) at 10% discount, plus net cash, equals last close (Jul 13, 2026). Profitable positive-FCF names only. Excluded: pre-revenue/negative-FCF story names (OKLO,SMR,IONQ,RGTI,CRWV,NBIS,ASTS,HTZ,APLD,TE,OPEN) and banks/insurers (GS,JPM,SOFI). TTM FCF/shares/cash from stockanalysis.com (confirmed current vs live fetch this run); prices refreshed to Jul 13 close.
